title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-26

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a smoking China>Rider and classic early‑80s gems, captured on a soundboard that sounds a bit tinny but still listenable
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its relentless energy, standout moments like the electrifying China → Rider transition, fresh “Touch of Grey” debut and a fiery Far From Me, while the recording – a classic SBD – is noted as being a bit tinny with low levels and drums‑forward mix. Despite those technical quirks the show is widely regarded as a dynamite late‑’82 set.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated very high (energy, standout songs) while recording quality is mixed but still acceptable; weighted combination yields ~4.1 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers call the SBD "tinny" with low overall levels; drums are very present and other instruments sound a bit muddled, though the classic board capture is still usable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual setlist for the era, mixing new songs (Touch of Grey, Throwing Stones) with early‑80s staples; transitions especially China>Rider are highlighted as electric.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Articulate work on "Eyes" and a generally powerful guitar presence – reviewers say he "goes off" throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for debuting his new 6‑string Modulus bass during this performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mix is drum‑heavy; reviewers hear every stick hit but note that other instruments can be buried.
